chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Razīn, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning:

Regarding a man who is apprehended while liable to multiple prescribed punishments, one of which is killing, he said: “ʿAlī عليه السلام would carry out the prescribed punishment upon him, then kill him, and we do not oppose ʿAlī عليه السلام.”

key_terms.الْحَدَّ: the specific prescribed punishment being implemented
key_terms.الْقَتْلُ: execution or killing as one of the legal penalties
key_terms.حُدُودٌ: prescribed legal punishments established in the Sacred Law
key_terms.عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam ʿAlī, whose legal practice is being followed as authoritative
key_terms.لَا نُخَالِفُ: we do not oppose or differ from

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a person is liable for multiple hudud punishments and one of them is execution?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a person upon whom multiple hudud are due, including execution. It states that Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام would first implement the prescribed hadd punishment and then execute him, and affirms adherence to the practice of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام.
